parsed.post: Experiment success! Decreasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 with DEPTH=8 yielded val_bpb 0.995615 (down from 1.005996). The increased number of optimizer steps is clearly helping the deeper model converge better within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing if a slightly higher learning rate can further accelerate this deeper configuration.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if more frequent updates and a slightly higher rate improve convergence for the DEPTH=8 model.
